name: 13_hand_card_to_person
title: Handing Card and Desk Organization
summary: The robot finishes handing a card to a person, closes the laptop, retrieves an adapter from a side cart, and reopens the laptop.
robot: silver robotic arm with a black dexterous hand
setting: office desk with a laptop, organizer tray, and a white side cart

source.original_prompt: pick up card and give it to the person

segments.instruction: Extend the card forward until the person grasps it, keeping the camera pointed at the person and laptop.
Release the card as the person takes it, and retract the hand back over the wooden organizer.
Reach toward the laptop display and push it down until the lid is completely closed.
segments.memory_event: hide: laptop screen and keyboard hidden beneath the closed lid

segments.instruction: Turn the camera left toward the white side cart and reach toward the white adapter on its top surface.
segments.memory_event: hide: the main desk, organizer, and laptop leave the view as the camera turns away

segments.instruction: Grasp the white adapter from the top shelf of the side cart while keeping the camera focused on the cart.
Turn the camera back to the main desk while holding the adapter.
segments.memory_event: return: main desk reappears with the wooden organizer and closed laptop exactly as left

segments.instruction: Place the white adapter onto the desk surface beside the wooden organizer.
Reach forward and lift the laptop lid open again.
segments.memory_event: return: laptop lid opened, revealing the screen and keyboard as originally seen
